prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE production icon atlas for Elements - Icons. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE; replace its subjects with the subjects specified here.
Rustic, earnest old-fashioned COLOURED WOODCUT. Match the supplied references' warm black, dull ochre, clay/rust red, slate blue, muted olive and creamy carved cuts, but visibly simpler and less polished than the first reference: a small number of broad confident cuts, occasional knife slips, uneven angular contours, slightly crooked handmade things, thin missed patches in ink and colour plates shifted slightly beyond or short of their black outlines. Imperfect registration must look printed, not blurred. No smooth gradients, modeled digital shading, tiny decorative hatching, glossy highlights, outline stickers, cute toy proportions, circular badges, frames or presentation shadows. Humble functional objects, easily recognised at 56 pixels. Natural, clear silhouettes before texture. Transparent outside each object.
EXACTLY FIVE columns and FOUR rows, 20 equal cells, wide 5:4 atlas. Keep every complete subject centered in its own cell with at least 15% TRANSPARENT MARGIN from all cell boundaries; strict grid with clear wide gutters. No labels or numbering, no drawn grid, no text except where explicitly requested. Do not repeat objects from the reference unless listed. Make the states of related objects clearly different, using silhouettes and visible contents.
READING ORDER:
1. Hinge: Plain dark iron strap hinge, two leaves joined by a visible pin, three nail holes
2. Dock: Short stout plank landing with four wooden posts extending above the deck, isolated construction
3. Sailboat: Modest flat-bottomed timber boat with one mast and one cream triangular sail, no mail or letters
4. Raft: Five rough logs lashed together, no mast or sail
5. Sail: One loosely folded cream triangular sail with two short attached ropes, no mast or boat
6. Pier post: One long squared timber post with a pointed lower end, one broad grain cut
7. Lighthouse: Plain cream masonry tower on a small rough stone footing, rust-red lantern cap with a warm light, no decorative castle
8. Mooring buoy: Closed ochre ceramic jar held in a wooden float frame, a clearly coiled mooring rope attached
9. Oil-soaked fiber wick: Dark oil-wetted twisted plant-fibre wick with a small golden oil drop, no flame or wood support
10. Oil-wick torch: Rough wooden stick bearing a bound fibre wick and a small rust-red flame
11. Lantern: Plain rectangular wooden-and-metal lantern with pale glass sides and a small visible flame, carrying loop
12. Tower: Plain unfinished cream brick tower with one small square window, open flat top, no lamp or light
13. Float: Closed empty ochre ceramic jar lashed in a small rectangular timber cradle, no rope coil or light
14. Supported garden: Small raised earth bed of leafy plants climbing a simple crossed-stick trellis
15. Greenhouse: Small sober timber greenhouse with large pale blue glass panes and seedlings visible inside
16. Seedlings: Three small seedlings with two leaves each in a little soil bed, no trellis
17. Trellis: Empty crossed-stick garden support tied with rough rope, no growing plants
18. Irrigated garden: Same leafy trellised bed with a clearly blue-filled wooden water trough feeding it from the side
19. Saw: Plain long toothed dark iron handsaw with a modest closed wooden grip
20. Hollow pipe: Long hollowed wooden log pipe with a clearly visible circular bore at its near end, thick bark wall
Keep all twenty separate, complete and rustic.
